_comment: The pipeline's description of itself. Rule placement, upstream resolution,
and provider capability negotiation all read this file. Editing it changes
what the system believes about its own shape, so it ships read-only and
operator rules are placed against it rather than into it.
Every capability listed under 'requires' must carry a 'reason' written for
the operator: a refusal has to explain the consequence, not name a flag.

stages.summary: Load fact base, rubric, rules and ledger state.
Propose candidate ideas against the brief.

reason.structured_output: candidates must arrive in a fixed shape; free text cannot be gated

stages.summary: Apply constraint predicates. Rejections name the failing rule.
Search for named competitors until the coverage cage is satisfied.

reason.structured_output: every competitor must carry a resolvable url, enforced at decode
reason.server_search: without search the model invents competitors instead of finding them

stages.summary: Adversarial pass in a fresh context; defaults to refuted under doubt.

reason.structured_output: a verdict must be a typed object, not prose
reason.server_search: a refutation with no source is an opinion, not a check

stages.summary: Compute the vector, apply thresholds, rank within track.
Write the dossier narrative. Emits no numbers.
Parse an operator's plain-language rule into a typed object.

reason.structured_output: a rule must compile to a typed object, never to prose
